description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build evaluation environments and benchmarks that measure whether AI agents can perform real-world company work and match or exceed human performance. This founding engineering role focuses on agent capability assessment and production readiness, with work that shapes how agent competence is measured.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design synthetic company environments with realistic email, records, and files for agents to use over extended tasks.

 - Build graders and evaluation systems that can reliably assess advanced AI agents.

 - Develop benchmarks that correlate with real-world production performance.

 - Find and address evaluation failure modes, including reward hacking and benchmark gaming.

 - Simulate software tools such as inboxes and CRMs with enough fidelity to support agent interactions at scale.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Mid-level or senior engineering or research experience, including at least 1 to 2 years at a fast-growing or AI-focused startup.

 - Hands-on AI research or engineering experience with synthetic data pipelines, benchmarks, evaluations, or post-training. This is a research-oriented role, not solely infrastructure engineering.

 - Experience building environments or benchmarks used to train or evaluate agents, and designing and implementing agent graders or evaluation systems.

 - Experience simulating complex software systems for agent tool use, identifying flaws in established benchmarks, and detecting and fixing reward hacking.

 - Background in AI evaluation, benchmark design, simulation, agent systems, or related areas. Startup founding or accelerator experience and high-level competition experience in mathematics, programming, debate, or games are valued.

 - Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in a fast-moving environment.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary is $200,000 to $300,000 annually, with up to $350,000 for exceptional candidates. Additional commission-style bonus compensation of up to $200,000 or more is tied to the value of delivered environments. Meaningful founding equity is included. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site five days a week in San Francisco, California, United States.
